seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. Note: Wabtec later reclassified some businesses between segments (e.g., Q1-14 10-Q shows Q1-13 Freight $313.7m / Transit $301.8m vs. originally reported $305.9m / $309.6m); figures here are as originally reported.
seg.notes: Segment income from operations (and Corporate Activities & Elimination) from the 10-Q segment note; the release does not publish segment operating income. legacy_pl = three-month 'Sales by product' table from the 10-Q segment note (as originally reported). Bridge from Q3-13 10-Q MD&A narrative: acquisitions +$34.8m (Freight $14.8m, Transit $20.0m); FX net -$6.3m (Freight -$8.3m, Transit +$2.0m). Organic not stated.

items.other_label: nonop = $1.0m currency translation expense in other expense; discrete_tax = $2.2m benefit from foreign deferred tax changes (sign: negative = would be removed in an adjustment). Disclosed only; not adjusted by company.

ngaap.guidance: Increased 2013 guidance for EPS to $3.00-$3.04, with revenues expected to be up about 8 percent for the year.
ngaap.notes: No adjusted EPS published. Release narrative discloses items included in GAAP results: pre-tax $1.9m contract charges (cost of sales), pre-tax $1.0m currency translation expense (other expense), and a $2.2m tax benefit from changes in deferred taxes in foreign jurisdictions. Recorded in items for reference only (no adjusted figures published).
